claims: Rick Barnes is the head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team.
Rick Barnes has held the position of head coach of the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team since 2015.
Rick Barnes was named the 2018-19 Naismith National Coach of the Year.
The Tennessee Volunteers have multiple Sweet 16 appearances under Rick Barnes' leadership.
Rick Barnes has signed a lifetime contract with Tennessee.
Rick Barnes led the Tennessee Volunteers to 8 straight NCAA Tournament appearances.
Rick Barnes led the Tennessee Volunteers to multiple SEC championships.
Rick Barnes led the Tennessee Volunteers to multiple Elite Eight berths.
Rick Barnes formerly coached at Clemson.
Rick Barnes formerly coached at Providence.
Rick Barnes formerly coached at George Mason.
Rick Barnes coached at Texas from 1998 to 2015.
Justin Gainey has been a key assistant staff member for the Tennessee Volunteers men’s basketball team.
Kim Caldwell is the head coach of the Tennessee Lady Volunteers.
